name: Landlubber’s Lozenges
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot none; Price 3,600 gp (for one dozen); Weight ½ lb.

DESCRIPTION

Originally created by a kindly ship captain who felt sorry for his seasick passengers, these ginger-flavored lozenges prevent the nausea and illness that so often come with traveling by water. One lozenge provides relief for three hours of sea or river travel. Any creature who takes a lozenge cannot become nauseated or sickened. They also help restore ones sense of balance, giving a +5 bonus to Dexterity-based skill checks involving movement. While it is recommended to allow the lozenge to dissolve on the tongue over the course of one minute, spending one round chewing up the tablet works just as well and brings relief more quickly. Landlubber’s Lozenges are easily found in communities near waterways, and are sold by the dozen in small water-tight tins.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, sea legs; Cost 1,800 gp (for one dozen).
